title: 30 Second Cover Letter?
description:
After your resume, cover letters are some of the most writing you’ll do during the job search. They can be a great introduction and overview of who you are but goodness, they do take some time. To save yourself as much time as possible, use ChatGPT to get one started. Tailor it a bit to make it sound more like you, and get some of those valuable hours back.
